name: Hide
source:
Next-seat classmate of [url=/c89999]Kuzumi[/url] at Rindoukan Academy.
He is an old friend of [url=/c124706]Gorou[/url], and they often play together. Although mostly covered by the strong presence of Gorou, he eggs Gorou on to play tricks from time to time.
